{{Quote|Following the defection of the Imperial Army infantry units of Wazta (see Imperial Communique #2734.19g), an unspecified number of Imperial Navy vessels and their crews have deserted.|Nasda, in a communique to Imperial Military Sector Commanders|<ref name="IS2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>}}
'''Wazta''' was a celestial body<ref name="IS2" /> located in the [[Wazta system/Legends|Wazta system]], a part of the [[Wazta sector/Legends|Wazta sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], multiple [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] units of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] at Wazta defected, after which several [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and their crews deserted, as well. The defections of the Wazta units were addressed in [[Imperial Communique 2734.19g|Imperial Communique #2734.19g]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Nasda]] later mentioned them in a communique sent to all [[Sector Commander]]s of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], as well. That communique was subsequently included in a compilation of Imperial documents made by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wazta was first mentioned in the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Wazta [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square J-18.<ref name="TEA" />
